mapper.select: SELECT t.teacher_id, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(d.dept_name), t.dept) AS dept, t.name, t.professional_title, t.position, t.birth, t.political, t.phone, t.officePhone, t.password, t.is_retired, t.is_full_time, t.education, t.staff_no, t.degree FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON td.dept_id = d.dept_id GROUP BY t.teacher_id

SELECT t.teacher_id, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(d.dept_name), t.dept) AS dept, t.name, t.professional_title, t.position, t.birth, t.political, t.phone, t.officePhone, t.password, t.is_retired, t.is_full_time, t.education, t.staff_no, t.degree FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON td.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY t.teacher_id

SELECT t.teacher_id, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(d.dept_name), t.dept) AS dept, t.name, t.professional_title, t.position, t.birth, t.political, t.phone, t.officePhone, t.password, t.is_retired, t.is_full_time, t.education, t.staff_no, t.degree FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON td.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE t.phone = #{phone} GROUP BY t.teacher_id

SELECT t.teacher_id, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(d.dept_name), t.dept) AS dept, t.name, t.professional_title, t.position, t.birth, t.political, t.phone, t.officePhone, t.password, t.is_retired, t.is_full_time, t.education, t.staff_no, t.degree FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON td.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE t.name = #{name} GROUP BY t.teacher_id LIMIT 1

SELECT t.teacher_id, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(d.dept_name), t.dept) AS dept, t.name, t.professional_title, t.position, t.birth, t.political, t.phone, t.officePhone, t.password, t.is_retired, t.is_full_time, t.education, t.staff_no, t.degree FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON td.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE t.staff_no = #{staffNo} GROUP BY t.teacher_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEACHER (dept, name, professional_title, position, birth, political, phone, officePhone, password, is_retired, is_full_time, education, staff_no, degree) VALUES (#{dept}, #{name}, #{professionalTitle}, #{position}, #{birth}, #{political}, #{phone}, #{officePhone}, #{password}, #{isRetired}, #{isFullTime}, #{education}, #{staffNo}, #{degree})
mapper.update: UPDATE TEACHER SET password = #{password} WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId}
mapper.select:
SELECT t.professional_title, COUNT(t.teacher_id) AS count FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id
td.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND t.professional_title IS NOT NULL AND t.professional_title != ''
GROUP BY t.professional_title

SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.birth, '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) <= 30 THEN '≤30岁' WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.birth, '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40岁' WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.birth, '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '41-50岁' WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.birth, '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) > 50 THEN '>50岁' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(t.teacher_id) AS value FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id
td.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND t.birth IS NOT NULL AND t.birth != '' AND t.birth REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(\\.[0-9]{1,2})?$'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT t.education AS name, COUNT(t.teacher_id) AS value FROM TEACHER t LEFT JOIN TEACHER_DEPT td ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id
td.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND t.education IS NOT NULL AND t.education != ''
GROUP BY t.education

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEACHER
AND (teacher_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKey}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKey}, '%'))
